messages:
sasha: Heads-up — shiplock (code freeze) starts today at 18:00 PT. If you need a freeze lift, reply with PR link + one-line risk statement + rollback plan. We'll triage exceptions until 17:30 PT. :warning:
ryan: docs-only bump: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/6826. No code changes — should that bypass?
sasha: Docs-only + changelog entry + green CI = usually OK. Add a changelog blurb and ping here when CI is green.
maria: Requesting exception for https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/6822 — small kv-cache init fix that improves warm start latency. CI flaky on unrelated test, I have a manual smoke plan. Risk: medium-low. Rollback: revert PR + redeploy previous runtime image.
jamal: Oncall — if it's a single-file change and we can run a quick staging smoke I'm +1. What's the smoke plan?
maria: Smoke steps:
```bash
# restart staging runtime and check health
kubectl -n staging rollout restart deploy/runtime
sleep 30
curl -sS https://staging.redwood/api/health | jq .
# run perf microbenchmark
python tools/loadtest.py --model small --tokens 256 --iters 20
```
alex: I ran the perf microbenchmark against the staging branch — p95 latency +~2ms, no error increase. I can provisionally approve if sasha + oncall are fine.
sasha: Format looks good. @jamal please confirm staging smoke results by 17:10 PT. If clear, we'll grant a one-time lift and gate the change to a daily canary with a rollback window.
jamal: smoke done — health OK, no error spikes, perf within acceptable margin. :thumbsup:
sasha: Exception approved. Maria, please add the rollback command to the PR description and tag @ops before merge. Keep the changelog entry concise.
maria: Done — rollback command added and ops tagged in PR. Will wait for ops ack then merge. Thanks everyone.
deploy-bot: Reminder — shiplock will be enforced at 18:00 PT. Please avoid direct merges after that time unless exception is granted.
